meta.name: anndata
meta.description: Data structure for annotated matrices in single-cell analysis. Use when working with .h5ad files or integrating with the scverse ecosystem. This is the data format skill—for analysis workflows use scanpy; for probabilistic models use scvi-tools; for population-scale queries use cellxgene-census.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 读入并组织单细胞测序产生的注释矩阵,为下游分析打好基础。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果处理单细胞测序结果,需要按注释矩阵整理基因表达数据。
copy.tagline_en: Read and organize annotated single-cell matrices for downstream analysis.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you handle single-cell sequencing data and need a standard way to organize annotated expression matrices.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 能创建、读取、写入和处理 AnnData 对象(单细胞等带注释数据矩阵),包括处理 .h5ad、.zarr 文件,以及对数据进行子集筛选、拼接、转置等操作。运行环境需 Python 3.11+。
howto.when: 当你提到 .h5ad、zarr 等单细胞数据文件,或要求与 scanpy、muon 等 scverse 生态工具配合处理数据时触发。

say.text: 读取这个 .h5ad 文件,告诉我里面有多少细胞和基因。
say.note: 调用 read_h5ad 打开文件并汇报维度。

say.text: 把这三个单细胞数据按细胞轴拼接,并标记来源批次。
say.note: 用 ad.concat 合并并加 batch 标签。

say.text: 用 backed 模式打开大文件,筛掉低质量细胞。
say.note: 以只读模式打开,按元数据过滤后取子集。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can create, read, write, and manipulate AnnData objects (annotated data matrices, typically single-cell), including .h5ad and .zarr files, plus subsetting, concatenation, and transposition. Requires Python 3.11+.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you mention .h5ad/zarr single-cell files or ask to work with scverse tools like scanpy or muon on such data.

say_en.text: Read this .h5ad file and tell me how many cells and genes it has.
Concatenate these three single-cell datasets along cells and label batches.
Open the large file in backed mode and filter out low-quality cells.
say_en.note: Reads read-only, filters by metadata, returns subset.
